tagline: Read a code from a photo. Nothing is uploaded.
description:
Take a still photo, or drop a picture. The words inside the code appear on the screen. There is no live camera view — one picture at a time, on this device. Nothing is sent anywhere, and there is no account.

A short history of what you have read stays in this file. It never leaves this device. Press Invite (the GifOS bar) if you want a friend to open the same app in a meeting; their history stays on their side.

An unofficial port of jsQR by cozmo. For making a code, use QR Code. For a Wi-Fi fridge card, use WiFi Card.
